Description:
An Umbraco-native discussion forum for Umbraco 17. Boards are Umbraco content (Forum > Category > Board) with real URLs, SEO fields and publishing; threads, posts, reports and profiles live in the package's own database tables, so conversation volume does not grow your content tree. Server-rendered throughout, with clean slugged URLs, DiscussionForumPosting and QAPage structured data, canonical tags, RSS and an XML sitemap.

Moderation ships with it. A deterministic rules engine scores every submission (spam lexicon, tiered profanity, obfuscation, link flooding, contact details) alongside admin-configured word lists, member reporting with auto-hide, a new-member gate, mute and ban. Moderators do not need backoffice accounts: add a member to the Moderators member group and they get a full moderation queue in the front end, inside your own community layout. Administrators get a unified backoffice queue covering forum posts and page comments together.

Also includes threads and replies, Latest/Newest/Unanswered/Top tabs, pagination, tags, polls, reactions, quoting, mark-as-answered, unread tracking, at-mentions, direct messages, an in-app notification centre, reply notification emails, member profiles, full-text Examine search, members-only boards excluded from every public listing, and self-service accounts with email verification and account deletion. Two-colour branding and dark mode.

In v1 the Forum node sits at the root of your content tree, and one Forum per installation is the supported shape. The optional DigitalWonderlab.CommunityAi add-on layers Umbraco.AI review on top. Free to use.
